arc.energy_shape_notes: One long plateau with potholes, loudest last. Db-major opening builds to Peak A at 3:00-5:00 (max 5s RMS -9.1dB at 4:50, peak -0.8dB at 3:15), then a long bright valley 5:00-8:40 (mean -16.1dB in its first minute, F minor), a rebuild 8:40-11:36, and a finale that inverts the album's other ending: deepest dip in the track (-19.8dB at 11:40) immediately before the loudest sustained passage in the piece (11:45-12:23, mean ~-10.0dB), then a hard stop at 12:23.0 at -9.3dB with no fade and no coda. Climax is the last thing that happens.

generator_hints.progression_note: One collection only (Db major / F natural minor). Tonicization drifts Db -> F minor -> Ab major across the track; no modulation, no chord leaves the collection.

harmony.home_scale: Db major collection (Db Eb F Gb Ab Bb C); tonicized in turn as Db major (0:00-3:00), F natural minor (5:00-8:40), Ab major (9:00-12:23)
signature_devices: One-collection tonicization drift: hold seven pitch classes for the whole track and move the tonic Db -> F min -> Ab maj. Tension from the tonic drifting, not functional motion. Naive key detectors report this as five modulations; it is one collection with three tonics.
F-minor stasis in the valley: nine consecutive 30s key windows read F min (5:00-8:30), F chroma 0.67-0.71, the strongest single pitch-class dominance in the track.
Ab-major close: G# chroma rises 0.66 -> 0.77 -> 0.79 across the rebuild and finale; final key window flips maj->min on a static Ab (detector relabeling, not an event).
No third-toggle vamp (unlike ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS): F holds 0.67-0.71 through the middle while E never exceeds 0.44. Ambiguity is which note is home, not whether the third is major or minor.
No leading tones, no V-i cadences observable; ends ambiguously on the Ab major/minor shadow.

Rock-stable bar grid: 333 onsets, mean spacing 2.236s (one 4-beat bar at 107.7 BPM), no drift, no tempo change anywhere. Per-minute estimator's 143.6 BPM reading for the first three minutes is a 4:3 artifact against constant bar spacing.
Hole before the slam: deepest dip in the track (-19.8dB at 11:40) immediately before the loudest sustained passage (-9.3dB at 11:45), a 10.5dB jump in one 5s step.

Pothole dynamics: 12 windows at -17dB or below scattered across the whole track; the floor never establishes itself. Dips cluster at structural turns (10:40 before the finale, 5:45-6:30 inside the valley).
No silence anywhere: quietest window is -19.8dB. Dips are holes, not voids.
Kick pattern, backbeat, and hats are NOT determinable from the available data (bar-resolution onsets only); do not invent them.

tempo.feel: Grid-locked at 107.7 BPM, no drift, no half-time switch, no accelerando. Bar spacing identical in the first and last minute (within 0.01s). Felt-pulse subdivision (107.7 vs half-time vs the detector's spurious 143.6) is not resolvable from bar onsets alone.

timbre.palette_notes: Bright throughout: centroid mean 3245Hz (range 1606-4054Hz), bandwidth mean 2860Hz, rolloff mean 6575Hz (max 8025Hz at 8:55), ZCR mean 0.12 (max 0.239 at 9:05). Valley is the brightest part (centroid 3449-3468Hz, ZCR 0.153-0.154 at 5:00-11:36) while sitting at -15 to -16dB: emptiness reads thin and noisy, not dark. Finale darkens in stages (centroid mean 2514Hz at 11:36-12:23) and collapses only in the final 5s window (centroid 1606Hz, rolloff 3855Hz, ZCR 0.033, anomalous MFCC frame MFCC1 -164.2). No sub-bass coda, no lowpass execution: the ending is a loudness event, not a timbral one. Loudest single window peaks at -0.8dB (3:15).
